signal: Olo was acquired by Thoma Bravo, acquired Spendgo for loyalty, and is building the Olo Network with a customer app launching late 2026.

email.subject1: a signal play for Olo's network
email.body1:
Jaime, saw Olo went private with Thoma Bravo, picked up Spendgo, and is standing up the Olo Network ahead of the app launch.

Building out a network usually means more partner and merchant accounts in play than the team can touch, and that is where co-sell pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the ecosystem autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Olo's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jaime, quick follow-up on the partnerships side.

A network play only works if every partner and merchant target actually gets worked, and that rarely scales with headcount alone. The fix is signal-to-meeting coverage that runs itself across the ecosystem, every touch auto-logged to your CRM.

I sketched a co-sell pilot playbook for the Olo Network. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through how it maps to your partner targets?
email.body3:
Jaime, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a pipeline gap analysis for your partnerships motion across the network. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through where the coverage holes are?
email.body4:
Jaime, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the network ramps, no problem at all. A take-private plus a new launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets? I will tailor them to Olo either way.
